# Future Ammunition - ADF Re-Cut

`jmfsb_fa_adf`

Future Ammunition in the ADF magazines the jmfsb factions issue: each one loaded with the FA round of its calibre, at tiers 2-4, in a jmfsb well the mod's weapons take. Written by `tools/gen_mod_factions.py`.
